entityDescription:
Lazzero Tecnologie srl is specialized in industrial vacuum leaktesting technologies. The core business of the Company is the design and manufacturing of industrial leak testing machines to determine if any kind of container is effectively leak proof. The Company offers also post-sale assistance and maintenance for such machines. The Company operates a metrological laboratory that produces reference leaks to calibrate leaktesting machines.
Over the years the Company became one of the most renowned worldwide and it is one of the leaders in the market.

The Company has established in 2024 a Space Business Unit, aimed at developing Space projects. The BU was awarded projects in excess of 2.3M€ by the Italian Space Agency and Piemonte Region, ranging from Phase A studies to TRL 5-6 prototypes, especially in the field of human spaceflight systems, equipments and payloads. With 5 FTE in the new Space Engineering Office in Torino, the Company works with public and private entities to bring to space projects, processes and ideas.

entityDescription:
As a world-leading facilitator of space programs, SSC Space enables governmental agencies, companies and other commercial or research institutes to make better use of space. 
Within our group of companies, SSC Space technologies and services enable successful space projects for the telecommunications, security, meteorology, positioning, scientific research, remote sensing or other industries. Through the unflagging efforts of our 700+ employees, we provide specialized competence in ground station networks, engineering services for space systems, space and satellite operations, rocket and balloon systems, suborbital and orbital launch services as well as rocket test services. 
Supporting customers with local presence on all continents, we offer extensive application-specific solutions comprised of systems, sub-systems, instruments, technology, and support services. Our more than 50 years of experience makes SSC Space one of the most experienced and established businesses in our field.
Since SSC Space was established by the government in 1972, the company has provided the main technical expert services needed to coordinate, implement and execute national and international activities, for both institutional and commercial space actors.

description:
At Lios, we believe the world shouldn’t have to choose between performance and peace. Our breakthrough acoustic material, SoundBounce, is transforming industries by delivering superior noise reduction in a compact, lightweight, sustainable, and high performance material. 
Born from over a decade of acoustic research, Lios is driven by science, innovation, and a commitment to creating a quieter, greener world. Whether it’s protecting workers from harmful noise, enhancing vehicle acoustics, or improving urban environments, we partner with forward thinking companies to solve their toughest noise challenges. 
SoundBounce will revolutionise how we combat noise in our world.
entityDescription:
Lios, formerly Restored Hearing, was founded in 2009 by Rhona Togher and Eimear O’Carroll.Our company mission of eradicating noise pollution is achieved through the development of materials which reduce the initial risk of exposure to loud noise and technologies which alleviate damage after it has occurred. Over the past decade, the company has grown into a powerhouse of innovative, expert problem-solvers. We have combined our advanced knowledge in physics with our experience of avoidable hearing damage. At Lios, we work tirelessly to combat noise pollution, meeting industry challenges head-on with a fresh perspective.
SoundBounce is a game-changing innovation in the acoustic materials industry. SoundBounce is a novel acoustic material for use in the automotive, aerospace, construction and power generation industries. SoundBounce is our response to noise pollution, providing the technology to enable a quieter world.

entityDescription:
Intecs Engineering is part of the Intecs Group, a leading Italian industrial and technological organization specializing in advanced engineering solutions and high-tech systems. Founded in 1974, Intecs began its activity in the field of software for advanced defence systems. Over nearly 50 years, it has expanded into the Space sector, developing a strong expertise in key technological areas ranging from satellite Earth Observation infrastructures and applications to GNSS and on-board/embedded systems. 

Intecs Engineering S.p.A. is an Italian private company at the forefront of designing and implementing high-tech electronic systems for the railway markets, where safety, reliability, innovation, and quality are key factors for success.
Intecs Engineering provides innovative software and hardware technologies, engineering services, and products for dependable safety- and mission-critical electronic systems. It designs and develops applications, tools, software, hardware components, and products in collaboration with major European and Italian industries, organizations, universities, and research centres.
As an international leader in System Engineering, Intecs Engineering masters the entire value chain — from prototypes, simulators, and automated test equipment to the final product.
Its core values are driven by a passion for technological excellence, continuous improvement, reliability, dedication, respect for individuals, and transparent relationships. These values have positioned Intecs Engineering among the most advanced high-tech companies in Europe.
Intecs Engineering shares with its customers the valuable expertise developed within its Centres of Excellence, which include:• Embedded Real-Time Systems• Model Driven Engineering• Verification and Validation• Human-Machine Interface (HMI)• GNSS Systems• Hardware, ASIC & FPGA Design• Artificial intelligence
• Physical & PCB Design
Intecs Engineering employs around 160 professionals, over 90% of whom hold university degrees in engineering, computer science, or other technical disciplines.
The company’s headquarters are in Rome, with additional operational sites in Pisa, Naples, Milan and Turin.

entityName: Oikon Ltd. - Institute of Applied Ecology
entityDescription:
Oikon d.o.o. – Institute of Applied Ecology is a leading licensed and accredited consulting company/research institute in the field of applied ecology in Croatia and the region. In its 25 years of experience, Oikon has successfully completed 1,650 contracts for over 400 satisfied clients.
The company offers services in the areas of nature and environment protection, industrial ecology, renewable energy, natural resource management, ecological modelling, landscape analysis and design, geographic information systems (GIS), Remote Sensing and ICT, environmental law, policy and economics, feasibility studies, as well as program and project management.
It is independently operated and privately owned and has the official status of scientific institute. In Croatia, it is officially licensed for activities in the fields of environmental and nature protection, geodesy, protection and conservation of cultural properties, and for development of forest management plans. 
Since 2019, Oikon has been a UNIGIS study centre and an entry point for students from nine Southeast European countries (Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Montenegro, Croatia, Kosovo, Northern Macedonia, Slovenia and Serbia) who attend online academic study courses in geoinformatics with degrees awarded by the University of Salzburg.
The company's strong belief in ethical corporate management, continuous education of its talented employees, leadership and innovation, high-quality management, social responsibility, customer focus and quality service has resulted in an image of competence and reliability. Its business activities are based on the integrated management system for quality, environment, occupational health and safety in compliance with the top international ISO standards.

entityDescription:
If today Università degli Studi di Camerino - UNICAM is one of the most interesting and innovative Italian institutions, it is, without doubt, the merit of the strength and momentum attributed to it by its rich history. UNICAM was fundend on XIII century (1259) and became State University on 1958 (Italian Law n. 254 13.03.1958).
With a solid scientific-cultural tradition,the University of Camerino now has five University Schools:Architecture and Design, Biosciences and Veterinary Medicine, Pharmaceutical and Health Products, Law, Science and Technology. As a university of European ambitions, Camerino has always been committed to developing a differentiated and cutting-edge educational offer; the highly innovative Master’s programmes and Doctoral PhD Programmes, the delocalisation of institutional teaching activities through the adoption of the most modern remote and online technologies, and the average first employment waiting time, which for the majority of UNICAM graduates is less than a year, testify to this fact. UNICAM is known for its strong commitment to scientific research, supported by state-of-the-art laboratories and research facilities. Its scientific laboratories, distributed across the various schools—such as the School of Science and Technology, the School of Biosciences and Veterinary Medicine, and the School of Pharmacy—are equipped for advanced research in areas like molecular biology, environmental science, chemistry, physics, and computer science. These labs play a central role in fostering innovation, supporting both fundamental and applied research, and encouraging collaboration at national and international levels. UNICAM is a key player in numerous national and international research projects, including European Union-funded initiatives under programs like Horizon Europe. These projects foster interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation, reinforcing UNICAM’s role within the global research community and contributing to technological and scientific advancement.

entityDescription:
Launcherscanner is a technology startup based in Italy, developing the first online marketplace dedicated to the new space economy. The platform connects satellite operators with launch providers, deployers, and carriers, enabling optimal mission planning for rideshare launches.
The company also develops AI-based tools to support the technical characterization of satellite payloads and to automatically identify the most suitable logistics and launcher combinations based on mission parameters.
Launcherscanner's core expertise includes:
System modeling (MBSE plugins for Capella)

Interoperable metadata standards for payloads and launch services

Backend and frontend development for aerospace platforms

Machine learning applied to launch matchmaking and mission feasibility analysis

The company aims to facilitate access to space for small satellite missions by reducing friction, costs, and time-to-launch through digital infrastructure and smart automation.
